skill.summary: Office文档翻译工具集。用于翻译和本地化办公文档（PPT/Word/PDF/Excel），保持原文档模板和格式不变。当用户说"翻译PPT"、"翻译Word文档"、"翻译PDF"、"翻译Excel"、"翻译文档"、"文档本地化"、"英文文档翻译成中文"时使用本技能。支持PPT/Word/PDF/Excel四种格...

latestVersion.changelog:
doc-translate 0.1.0

- Initial release of the Office document translation toolkit.
- Supports translation of PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF formats while preserving templates and styles.
- Enables English-to-Chinese (and other language) localization for office documents.
- Provides workflow details, key file structures, and translation scripts for each supported format.
- Includes guidelines for handling Feishu files and sending large documents.
- Outlines translation quality safeguards for technical terms, brands, numbers/units, and formatting.
